backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the backend for a pepper farm bookkeeping app, handling admin bootstrap registration, user profiles, and an approval system with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component's role in the pepper farm bookkeeping application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'Pepper Farm Bookkeeping Application' and mounting the app at the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component orchestrating authentication, bootstrap registration, profile setup, and approval-state routing to render LoginPrompt, WaitingForApprovalScreen, or Dashboard based on user status.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying the current year and a caffeine.ai attribution link with dynamic UTM parameters derived from the app's hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header showing the farm branding, the authenticated user's name, and a login/logout button that clears React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Landing page for unauthenticated users featuring a hero image and four feature cards highlighting income tracking, inventory, customers, and the financial dashboard.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that collects a new user's name on first login and saves it via the saveCallerUserProfile mutation, blocking interaction until submitted.
frontend/src/components/RejectedScreen.t: Displays a rejection screen for users whose farm access request was denied, with a sign-out button that clears the identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AttendanceT: Renders a workers management tab that lists farm workers and provides a dialog form to add new workers with a name and role.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CustomersTa: Displays a customers list with search, add-customer dialog, and a per-customer purchase history dialog showing sales records.
Manages farm expense records with full CRUD operations, category filtering, search, and a total expenses summary displayed in Nigerian Naira.
frontend/src/components/tabs/FarmTimeTab: Provides a monthly calendar view for tracking worker daily attendance, allowing users to record presence, arrival, and departure times per worker per day.
frontend/src/components/tabs/IncomeTab.t: React component for displaying and adding farm income records, with search/filter by source, a dialog form for new entries, and Naira-formatted totals.
frontend/src/components/tabs/InventoryTa: React component for managing farm inventory items, supporting add/edit via a dialog form, filtering by item type, and displaying total inventory value.
frontend/src/components/tabs/SalesTab.ts: React component for recording and viewing farm sales transactions, linking customers and inventory items, with search and total revenue calculation.
Dashboard summary tab that aggregates income, expenses, net profit, inventory value, and low-stock alerts, plus a list of recent transactions.
frontend/src/components/tabs/Verificatio: Admin tab for managing user access approvals, allowing admins to approve or reject pending principal requests with status badges and a refresh action.
frontend/src/components/WaitingForApprov: Shows a pending approval screen where users can send an approval request and refresh their approval status while waiting for a farm member to grant access.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profiles, approvals, inventory, sales, income, expenses, customers, workers, and attendance records.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines light/dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page component that renders a tabbed interface with sections for summary, income, expenses, inventory, customers, sales, attendance, farm time, and an admin-only verification tab.
frontend/src/utils/farmTime.ts: Utility functions for the Farm Time calendar feature, including date/nanosecond conversions, calendar grid generation, time parsing/formatting, and duration formatting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, content paths, extended theme tokens (colors using oklch CSS variables, border radius, shadows, accordion keyframes), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state descriptor (version 3) tracking three pending fix requests: making recently added buttons visible with correct styling, wiring button onClick handlers to correct mutations/actions, and ensuring the 'Entered By' field is fully connected to the backend across relevant tabs.
